title: የአያቴ የገበያ መንገድ (Grandmother's Market Path)
logline: At dawn in the highlands, an elderly grandmother walks the red-earth path to market carrying woven baskets and quiet resilience that still guides her family today.
style_block: Warm 35mm documentary film still, golden morning highland light, natural earth tones and woven textures, subtle film grain, centered subject composition for dual-aspect framing, no text or watermarks.

character_reference.name: Emayework (Grandmother)
character_reference.description: Elderly Ethiopian grandmother in her late 60s, warm weathered face, white cotton netela shawl draped neatly over shoulders, calm steady eyes, carrying a handwoven basket.

music_cues.caption: Gentle acoustic krar and soft warm cello underscore, peaceful morning highland mood, understated slow melody leaving space for spoken narration, warm natural room texture

shots.reason: Establishes the misty highland dawn and the winding red-earth path before introducing the character.
shots.image_prompt: Misty highland hills at first light, winding red earth footpath through green terraces and eucalyptus trees, soft morning fog lifting.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow gentle camera push-in along the misty path, soft morning breeze moving tall grass.
shots.narration_local: ገና ጎህ ሳይቀድ፣ የደጋው ጭጋግ ገና ሳይበተን፣ አያቴ ወደ ገበያ የሚወስደውን ቀይ የአፈር መንገድ ትይዛለች።
shots.narration_en: Before dawn fully breaks, while highland mist still lingers, my grandmother takes the red-earth path toward market.

shots.reason: Introduces Grandmother with her netela and woven basket so viewers connect with her calm presence.
shots.image_prompt: Elderly Ethiopian grandmother in white cotton netela holding a woven basket, walking along a quiet highland path in soft morning light, centered framing.
shots.motion_prompt: Gentle steady tracking shot as she walks forward calmly, netela fabric swaying softly.
shots.narration_local: በትከሻዋ ላይ የተጣለው ነጭ ነጠላ እና በእጇ የያዘችው ቅርጫት የዘመናት ትዕግሥት ምልክቶች ነበሩ።
shots.narration_en: The white netela draped over her shoulders and the woven basket in her hand carried decades of quiet patience.

shots.reason: Highlights weathered hands and woven craft as a tactile motif of care and preparation.
shots.image_prompt: Close-up of weathered elderly hands resting gently on a handwoven straw basket rim in warm morning sunlight, shallow depth of field.
shots.motion_prompt: Very subtle slow camera drift, warm sunlight shifting gently across the woven fibers.
shots.narration_local: እጆቿ ብዙ ድካምን ቢያውቁም፣ እያንዳንዱን ነገር በጥንቃቄ እና በፍቅር ማዘጋጀትን አላቋረጡም።
shots.narration_en: Though her hands knew hard labor, she never stopped preparing every detail with care and affection.

shots.reason: Captures her facial expression and quiet determination as the journey steepens.
shots.image_prompt: Medium close-up of elderly Ethiopian grandmother with warm calm expression and gentle eyes in golden morning light, soft blurred background.
shots.motion_prompt: Subtle breathing motion and gentle blink, camera holds nearly still with minimal warmth.
shots.narration_local: መንገዱ ሲያቀበትም ሆነ ሲወርድ፣ የፊቷ መረጋጋት ለቤተሰባችን ትልቅ ጥንካሬ ነበር።
shots.narration_en: Whether the path climbed steep hills or dipped down, her calm face was a steady anchor for our family.

shots.reason: Shows the transition from quiet trail toward distant market activity and community gathering.
shots.image_prompt: Wide view of a small highland market approach in morning light, distant colorful umbrellas and people gathering, red earth road leading in.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow gentle pan right across the sunlit hillside toward the distant market.
shots.narration_local: ከሩቅ የገበያው ድምጽ መሰማት ሲጀምር፣ የቀኑ እንቅስቃሴ አዲስ ምዕራፍ ይከፍታል።
shots.narration_en: As distant sounds of the market begin to rise, the rhythm of the day opens a new chapter.

shots.reason: Shows respectful greeting and shared community warmth along the way.
shots.image_prompt: Elderly Ethiopian grandmother pausing on a sunlit path to exchange a warm respectful greeting with a neighbor, natural candid documentary look.
shots.motion_prompt: Gentle natural movement as they greet warmly in soft morning light, camera static.
shots.narration_local: በመንገድ የሚያጋጥሟትን ሰዎች በአክብሮት ሰላም ማለት እና መጠያየቅ የዕለት ተዕለት ልማዷ ነበር።
shots.narration_en: Greeting neighbors with respect and asking how their households fared was part of every morning.

shots.reason: Delivers the emotional turning point: a family proverb remembered across generations.
shots.image_prompt: Intimate close-up of elderly Ethiopian grandmother smiling softly in warm golden sunlight, soft bokeh background, peaceful expression.
shots.motion_prompt: Very gentle slow push-in toward her warm eyes and soft smile.
shots.narration_local: ሁልጊዜ የምትለን አንድ ምሳሌ አለች፡ ትዕግሥት የመራራውን ፍሬ ወደ ጣፋጭ ይለውጣል።
shots.narration_en: She always leaves us with one proverb: patience turns even a bitter fruit sweet.

shots.reason: Connects the past story to the present day through a shared object or memory.
shots.image_prompt: Warm sunlit wooden table inside a modest home with a woven basket and a small cup of coffee, peaceful quiet morning light, centered composition.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow gentle camera pan across the table in soft morning light.
shots.narration_local: ዛሬ እኛም በራሳችን መንገድ ስንጓዝ፣ ያ ታሪክ እና ያ ምክር አብረውን ይጓዛሉ።
shots.narration_en: Today, as we walk our own paths, that story and her counsel walk beside us.

shots.reason: Brings back the visual motif of the journey with renewed clarity and warmth.
shots.image_prompt: Elderly Ethiopian grandmother standing calmly along a sunlit red-earth path framed by green highlands at golden hour, centered subject.
shots.motion_prompt: Gentle breeze in surrounding greenery, slow subtle camera pull-back.
shots.narration_local: ትውስታዋ የትላንትናን ብቻ ሳይሆን የነገንም መንገድ የሚያበራ ብርሃን ነው።
shots.narration_en: Her memory is not only yesterday's trace, but light for the road ahead.

shots.reason: Closes the narrative arc cleanly before the AI disclosure end card.
shots.image_prompt: Sunlit highland landscape and winding red path bathed in warm golden light as morning settles into clear day, calm serene composition.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow gentle drift as warm light settles evenly across the valley.
shots.narration_local: የአያቴ መንገድ በልባችን ውስጥ ዛሬም ሕያው ነው።
shots.narration_en: Grandmother's path lives on in our hearts today.
